about_the_game:
This game is an innovative twist on classic snake - style games, building its core gameplay around a minimalist 2D cartoon aesthetic. Set against a bright green background, a tiger - shaped snake head leads a body made of red circular segments. Players must dodge black stone obstacles while devouring bright red apples to score points and lengthen the snake.

Core Mechanics & Innovations

It inherits the classic snake loop of “eat → grow → escalate in difficulty”, but redefines the challenge with static black stones. The snake must avoid not only self - collision, but also navigate around rocks—even predicting pathing as its body grows. Each apple eaten boosts the score by 1 and extends the snake; as length increases, demands for precision and spatial strategy skyrocket. Players balance “greedy growth” against “survival,” with reflexes and decision - making tested relentlessly.

Visuals & Experience

The interface is stripped - down: a “Score” at the top tracks progress, and an “Exit” button in the top - right enables quick exits, perfect for short play sessions. Visual design is playful: the tiger - headed snake adds charm, apples stand out clearly, and black stones signal danger unambiguously. The pace ramps up with the snake’s length—starting as relaxed apple - collecting, then devolving into frantic maneuvers to avoid tangling in its own body or hitting obstacles. This creates a satisfying “easy to start, hard to master” thrill.

Controls

Move Up = W

Move Down = S

Move Left = A

Move Right = D
